name: Mike's Welding
old_description: The Kenai River Dip Net season from July 10th-31st we will be open until 7 pm on friday evenings and open 8-5 on Saturdays to handle overload dip net sales and repairs. See the dip net page for hours during this season.
about:
Mike's Welding operates from a storefront and workshop at 33920 Sterling Highway in Sterling, Alaska, with a mailing address at PO Box 627. The business has maintained a web presence since at least 2015, though the exact founding date and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. The shop serves the local community and seasonal visitors along the Kenai Peninsula.

The shop specializes in welding and metal fabrication, with a notable seasonal focus on dip net sales and repairs for the Kenai River personal use fishery. During the annual dip net season from July 10 to 31, the facility extends its hours, opening until 7:00 p.m. on Fridays and operating 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. on Saturdays to handle increased demand. Regular hours run Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

Primary customers include participants in the Kenai River dip net fishery—both Alaska residents and non-residents—who purchase new nets or bring existing gear for repair and custom modification. The shop also addresses general welding and fabrication needs for residents and businesses in the Sterling area.

The company differentiates itself by aligning its schedule with the time-sensitive dip net season, ensuring availability when demand peaks. This seasonal responsiveness, combined with on-site fabrication capability, allows Mike's Welding to serve both immediate repair needs and custom orders for the fishery.
